headword: {開口一番|かいこういちばん}
gloss: the first thing one says; right off, as soon as one speaks

definitions.gloss: the very first thing one says; first words
definitions.explanation: What someone says the moment they open their mouth, before anything else. Usually used adverbially, with or without に, to report someone's first words, often as a sign of what was most on their mind.

examples.japanese: {開口一番|かいこういちばん}「⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧！」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The first thing he said to me was "You're late!"

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開口一番|かいこういちばん}、⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}した→謝罪する：19520_shazaisuru⟧。
⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開口一番|かいこういちばん}「⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧すいた」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The first thing my son said when he came home was "I'm hungry."

notes:
A four-character compound: {開口|かいこう} (opening the mouth) + ⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧ (first). It reports someone's first words, so it usually comes with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ or a verb of speaking, and the quoted words follow it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {開口一番|かいこういちばん}「…」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say "…" first thing
- {開口一番|かいこういちばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧…: as one's opening words, …
- ⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{開口一番|かいこういちばん}: at the very start of a press conference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {第一声|だいいっせい}: one's first words, as a noun (〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{第一声|だいいっせい}); {開口一番|かいこういちばん} works like an adverb
- ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧: abruptly; does not have to be about speech
